title: Northbeam TechWorks Cover and Discount Applicability by Service
content:
Whether labour is carried free of charge, and whether a member's repair labour discount reaches it at all, is settled per TechWorks service before any figure is worked out. Three applicability flags are carried for each Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair service: whether labour is covered without charge when the work is manufacturer warranty work, whether labour is covered without charge when a protection plan authorises the work, and whether the Circle tier's repair labour discount is applied to chargeable labour.

| TechWorks service | Labour covered on manufacturer warranty work | Labour covered when a protection plan authorises the work | Circle repair labour discount applied to chargeable labour |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | yes | yes | yes |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | yes | yes | yes |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | yes | yes | yes |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | yes | yes | yes |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | yes | yes | no |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | yes | yes | no |

### What the three columns separate

All six TechWorks services cover labour without charge on manufacturer warranty work, and all six cover labour without charge where a protection plan authorises the work. The third flag is the one that divides them: the four consumer-facing services apply the Circle tier's repair labour discount to chargeable labour, while the two business services — TechWorks Business On Site Deployment and TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual — do not.
